items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, we went to high school together and we used to live next door to each other... In fact I spoke with Joe yesterday.

ctx.x: You and Joe went to high school together?

Yeah, we went to high school together and we used to live next door to each other, when we were both about 15 years old, because I think -- Joe just had his birthday. We're the same age, only two weeks apart.
Yeah, and Joe's two weeks older than you, right?
